main.description: Returns one indexed location by AT-URI; authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full location AT-URI with a DID authority; lookup matches the URI, not a CID.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed location exists at this AT-URI.

locationView.description: Indexed location with its original record and hydrated author.

author.description: Author DID with indexed profile and organization views; missing records are null, while lookup failures fail the query.
